race.name: Okanagan Graveller

climate.description: The organizer says June mountain conditions can include sunshine, wind, rain, heat, or all four in one day. Prepare for exposed summer heat at lower elevations and cooler, rapidly changing conditions on the forest-road climbs.

terrain.surface: The 2027 event moves to Telemark Nordic Club and advertises rugged forest service roads, long sustained climbs, fast gravel descents, and a true backcountry setting.

gravel_god_rating.score_note: A legitimate timed third-edition event with a strong mountain venue, three distances, and real race categories. The organizer's conflicting 120 km elevation claims and unpublished 2027 routes cap the grade at 60 until the course pack lands.

biased_opinion.summary: Telemark Nordic Club gives this race a much sharper identity than a generic valley gravel ride: 120 km of long forest-road climbs, rugged backcountry, fast gravel descents, timed results, and real podium categories. The stable demands are specific enough to train now. The page currently contradicts itself on the Boulder elevation, so the plan and guide leave exact gain and route execution to the promised final maps.
weaknesses: No published 2027 start time or final aid-station map
Young event with limited field-depth evidence
biased_opinion.bottom_line: Train the stable challenge now: 120 km of sustained mountain climbing, rugged forest roads, fast loose descents, backcountry fueling, and variable June weather. Use the final rider documents for exact elevation, turns, and aid locations.

final_verdict.one_liner: A 120 km Okanagan mountain-gravel race where sustained climbing, backcountry fueling, and late loose-surface descending decide the day.
final_verdict.should_you_race: Yes if you want a community-forward mountain gravel weekend in British Columbia. The date, venue, distance, climbing-heavy character, support model, and cutoff are firm enough to prepare for; verify the final map and gain before race week.
final_verdict.alternatives: For an established Canadian mountain-gravel benchmark, compare The Last Best Ride or one of the Triple Crown of Gravel events.
